post.text:
Gracie the bear was rescued after years of living in captivity.

This is her reaction to newfound freedom..🐻🙏🥺🥰

📹wildlifesos https://t.co/GawEOTWHgW
post.author_description: Funny, good and  upbeat videos of 🐶🐱🐻🐺🐨🐼🌏🐧🐬🐳🐾🐝🐟🐠🏞️👶

description.description: A close-up of a bear in a grassy enclosure, with its body facing away from the camera. The bear is dark and furry, and it is standing on its hind legs, reaching up with its front paws to grab onto the trunk of a tree. The tree is thick and dark, and its branches are covered in green leaves. In the background, there is a green fence and some trees. The bear is standing in a lush, green grassy area. The bear is looking up at the tree, and its head is tilted back. Its front paws are resting on the trunk of the tree, and its hind legs are slightly bent. The bear's fur is thick and dark, and it is covered in some dirt. The overall mood of the image is peaceful and tranquil.
